Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

    When you log-in/call-in, except for meeting presenters and speakers, all
  microphones and video cameras will be muted/off.
    When you are making public comments, you line will be unmuted.

  Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit comments for
  consideration by the Arts Commission by sending them to Stephanie Maldondado,
  Senior Management Assistant, at smaldonado@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Arts Commission prior to consideration of the
  agenda, comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on January 18, 2023, the
  day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda
  item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. will be made part of the official public
  record of the meeting.

minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  January 18, 2023

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on January 18, 2023 via
Zoom. Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the
flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large
  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Phyllis
  Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner

  Absent:  Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Sabrina Barnes  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

STAFF REPORT. Inglewood Transit Connector Art Program – Receive and File. Staff report
recommending the Arts Commission receive and file the report regarding the proposed
Inglewood Transit Connector Public Art Program.

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. It Takes a Village artwork framed and installation
  b. The Written Word column art conservation RFQ
  c. Twenty Years of Making Percent for Art book NEA grant application

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Otis College Report on the Creative Economy – February 10 at LAPL Central Library
  b. Next Arts Commission meeting on February 15, 2023 at 6:30 p.m.

PUBLIC REMARKS. Chief Duane Yellow Feather Shepard shared his concerns about a few
items he would like to see addressed at the Willie E. Agee Playhouse located at Edward
Vincent Park.

  1
   Arts Commission

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:19 p.m.
